hero.title: Ranks of Mōchirīī
hero.intro: Trust grows in the small moments. Show up when you can, lend a hand & be nice.

progression.title: How ranks grow
body: We notice the habits with being consistent & reward that trust over time.
Ask a middle leader first. Hall Leaders handle wider guild concerns, Vice Leaders & the Guild Leader guide larger decisions.

senior.title: Senior Leadership
senior.description: Senior leaders keep the guild active & look after its people.

ranks.name: Guild Leader
body: Sets the guild’s course & makes the final call with decisions.

ranks.name: Vice Leader
body: Carries plans across the ranks & steps in when the Guild Leader is away.

ranks.name: Hall Leader
body: Looks after one hall & handles its wider needs.

middle.title: Middle Leadership
middle.description: Middle leaders stay close to daily guild life. They welcome members & keep things moving.

ranks.name: Dharmapala
body: Leads day-to-day coordination & settles routine concerns.

ranks.name: Lotus Warden
body: Welcomes newcomers & answers their first questions.

ranks.name: Petal Keeper
body: Shares updates & helps members join guild life.

members.title: Members
members.description: Members give Mōchirīī its life. Each rank marks trust shown through habits over time.

ranks.name: Mochi Blossom
body: A trusted veteran who has shared many seasons & helped the guild feel like home.

ranks.name: Young Bamboo
body: A rooted member who joins in often & contributes with most activities.

ranks.name: Softwind
body: A familiar face who knows the guild & takes part with generosity.

ranks.name: Rice Sprout
body: A new member learning the guild & beginning to build trust.
